title: truthllm: Expression-and-Revision Layer over a Fixed Language Model — Reference Implementation, Benchmark, and Results
description: Reference implementation and measured evaluation accompanying the paper 'Truth for Believable AI: Expressed Doubt, Provenance, and Belief Revision as an Engineerable Stance'. Includes the truthllm layer (three epistemic states, per-claim confidence and typed provenance, a frozen provenance-gating table, a persistent belief store with defined revision triggers, a correction-acceptance rule with false-correction resistance, and auditable acknowledgments), a versioned multi-session contradiction-and-correction benchmark with SHA-256 manifests and a language-agnostic scorer, cached pinned-model outputs (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct at a recorded revision), seed-reproducible one-command evaluation scripts, all results files behind every number in the paper, and the test suite. Honesty notes: all outcomes are machine-scored against generator-injected ground truth on one 60-fact world and one 0.5B model; several pre-specified margins fail and are reported as failures; no believability, trust, or human-perception effect is measured.
